title: The Deathwalker
description: You buried the nameless dead, freed one lingering spirit, stood watch at a desecrated cemetery, stopped a frightened old man from becoming what the priest despises most, and held two towns against a rising tide he could not have held alone. The Priest of Morthane offers the last test - to become a Deathwalker, one who can cross into death's edge and return, and confront what an undead lord makes of the cycle he still, after everything, refuses to forgive.

objectives.description: Meditate at the Shrine of Endings to prepare
Undergo the Death Walk ritual (near-death experience)
Journey to the entrance of Kazer-Dun
Enter the ancient catacombs beneath Kazer-Dun
Clear the catacombs of lesser undead
Confront the Undead Lord in the deep catacombs
Claim Morthane's blessing at the ancient altar
Return to the Priest as a Champion of Morthane

notes: Threat/consequence: capstone recap of the doctrine running through morthane_01-09 - death respected, undeath refused, no exceptions made for sympathy. Added world_flags_to_set (morthane_deathwalker_named) to the existing become_champion consequence, free per spec since the entry already existed. Giver motive: the priest is not sentimental about the title; it marks someone the cycle can rely on.
